plugin_desc: Netonix 户外 PoE 交换机专用 SNMP 采集（IANA 私有企业号 46242）。在标准 IF-MIB 接口指标之外，额外采集机箱温度表（tempDescription + temp，℃）、风扇转速（fanSpeed，RPM）、电压表（voltageDescription + voltage，VoltageTC ÷100 → V）和总功耗标量（totalPowerConsumption，PowerTC ÷10 → W）；可选采集 DCDC 输入电流（CurrentTC ÷10 → A）与 DCDC 效率（%）。无私有 CPU/内存 OID，本插件不臆造这两项。适用品牌型号——Netonix WISP Switch 系列 PoE 交换机。
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the chassis temperature in degrees Celsius of the Netonix switch (temp table, Integer32 °C), tagged by tempDescription. High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: This metric reports the fan rotation speed in RPM of the Netonix switch (fanSpeed, Integer32, indexed by fanIndex). Abnormally low or zero RPM indicates a stalled or failed fan and a risk of overheating; abnormally high RPM may indicate the device is compensating for high temperature. The private MIB exposes RPM only, not a fan-state enum.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: This metric reports the supply voltage in volts of the Netonix switch (voltage table, VoltageTC scaled by 1/100 via starlark), tagged by voltageDescription. A reading far from the rated input voltage indicates unstable power or a failing supply.

metrics.name: device_power_watts
metrics.description: This metric reports the chassis total power consumption in watts of the Netonix switch (totalPowerConsumption scalar, PowerTC scaled by 1/10 via starlark). A sudden rise may indicate PoE load growth, a shorted powered device, or a failing PSU.

metrics.name: device_dcdc_input_current
metrics.description: This optional metric reports the DCDC input current in amperes of the Netonix switch (dcdcInputCurrent scalar, CurrentTC scaled by 1/10 via starlark). It helps correlate power draw with input voltage on outdoor PoE switches.

metrics.name: device_dcdc_efficiency
metrics.description: This optional metric reports the DCDC conversion efficiency of the Netonix switch (dcdcEfficiency scalar, Integer32 percent). A sustained drop may indicate converter aging or overload.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
